At some point, the [[Bitthævrian/Legends|Bitthævrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Aul Tarrus Vishav]] '''escaped''' from [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] at the foothills of the [[u'Tal'ac Range]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Guiteica/Legends|Guiteica]]. The carnage left behind in Tarrus' escape gained a legendary status among the other slaves of the [[Upper Bal'ta'ran Cluster]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]].<ref name="AIR">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>
